description: This file implements the MPSCNNClampOp class, which performs a clamp operation on input textures for Metal-based GPU processing, specifically within the PyTorch framework's Metal backend. It defines methods for creating an instance and encoding GPU commands for execution.

classes.name: MPSCNNClampOp
classes.description: Objective-C class that wraps a GPU clamp operation for textures, initialized with two textures and clamp bounds, and capable of encoding GPU commands for Metal.

methods.name: newWithTextures:Args:
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a MPSCNNClampOp with input textures and clamp arguments.

methods.name: encode:
methods.description: Encodes GPU commands to perform the clamp operation on the specified command buffer.
